description: Independent side models. Data collection only: nothing here feeds any pick, slip, record or track.

models.name: League base rate
models.desc: How often games in the same league finished under the line this season. Needs no outlook data. Season-to-date rates include the games being scored.

models.name: Bet365 price
models.desc: Bet365 price converted to a chance, with an assumed 5% bookmaker margin removed. Needs no outlook data.

models.name: Poisson
models.desc: Plain Poisson goals around the projected total.

models.name: Negative binomial
models.desc: Like Poisson but allows more wild games (very low and very high scores) than Poisson does. Dispersion fixed at 12, not fitted.

models.name: Bivariate Poisson
models.desc: Home and away goals share a common source, so they move together and very high or very low totals are more likely than plain Poisson. Shared part fixed at 10%, not fitted.

models.name: Markov chain
models.desc: Minute-by-minute score chain: the leader slows a little, the trailing team pushes a little.

models.name: Outlook chance
models.desc: The outlook data's own Under 2.5 chance, for reference. Not available for Under 3.5.

models.name: Blend (equal mix)
models.desc: Plain average of every model above that has a number for the game, excluding the outlook reference.
